#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <set>
#include <map>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

const double eps = 1e-8;

struct Point {
    double x, y;
    Point() : x(0), y(0) {}
    Point(double x, double y) : x(x), y(y) {}
    Point add(const Point& o) const {
        return Point(x + o.x, y + o.y);
    }
    Point sub(const Point& o) const {
        return Point(x - o.x, y - o.y);
    }
    Point rotate(double alpha) const {
        double c = cos(alpha);
        double s = sin(alpha);
        return Point(x * c - y * s, x * s + y * c);
    }
    Point norm() const {
        double len = length();
        return scale(1.0 / len);
    }
    Point scale(double f) const {
        return Point(f * x, f * y);
    }
    double length() const {
        return sqrt(x * x + y * y);
    }
    string toString() const {
        char buf[64];
        sprintf(buf, "%.6f %.6f", x, y);
        return string(buf);
    }
    bool operator==(const Point& o) const {
        return fabs(x - o.x) < eps && fabs(y - o.y) < eps;
    }
    bool operator<(const Point& o) const {
        if (fabs(x - o.x) > eps) return x < o.x;
        if (fabs(y - o.y) > eps) return y < o.y;
        return false;
    }
};

struct Circle {
    Point o;
    double r;
    bool contains(const Point& p) const {
        return fabs(p.sub(o).length() - r) < eps;
    }
};

vector<Point> intersect(const Circle& c1, const Circle& c2) {
    double dx = c1.o.x - c2.o.x;
    double dy = c1.o.y - c2.o.y;
    double d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    double cosVal = (c1.r * c1.r + d * d - c2.r * c2.r) / (2 * c1.r * d);
    if (cosVal < -1 - eps) {
        return vector<Point>();
    }
    if (cosVal < -1) {
        cosVal = -1;
    }
    if (cosVal > 1 + eps) {
        return vector<Point>();
    }
    if (cosVal > 1) {
        cosVal = 1;
    }
    vector<Point> res;
    double alpha = acos(cosVal);
    Point dir = c2.o.sub(c1.o).norm();
    res.push_back(c1.o.add(dir.scale(c1.r).rotate(+alpha)));
    res.push_back(c1.o.add(dir.scale(c1.r).rotate(-alpha)));
    return res;
}

void dfs(int i, vector<bool>& was, const vector<vector<int>>& adj) {
    was[i] = true;
    for (int j : adj[i]) {
        if (!was[j]) {
            dfs(j, was, adj);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<Circle> circles(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int x, y, r;
        cin >> x >> y >> r;
        circles[i].o = Point(x, y);
        circles[i].r = r;
    }

    set<Point> allPoints;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
            vector<Point> interPoints = intersect(circles[i], circles[j]);
            if (!interPoints.empty()) {
                for (const auto& p : interPoints) {
                    allPoints.insert(p);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    map<Point, int> pointId;
    vector<vector<int>> adj;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        vector<double> angles;
        const int K = 3;
        for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
            angles.push_back(2 * M_PI * j / K);
        }
        for (const auto& p : allPoints) {
            if (circles[i].contains(p)) {
                double dx = p.x - circles[i].o.x;
                double dy = p.y - circles[i].o.y;
                double alpha = atan2(dy, dx);
                if (alpha < 0) alpha += 2 * M_PI;
                angles.push_back(alpha);
            }
        }
        sort(angles.begin(), angles.end());
        Point dir = Point(1, 0).scale(circles[i].r);
        vector<double> uniqueAngles;
        for (size_t j = 0; j < angles.size(); j++) {
            if (j == 0 || fabs(angles[j] - angles[j - 1]) > eps) {
                uniqueAngles.push_back(angles[j]);
            }
        }
        vector<Point> pointsOnCircle;
        for (double a : uniqueAngles) {
            Point p = circles[i].o.add(dir.rotate(a));
            if (pointId.find(p) == pointId.end()) {
                int sz = (int)pointId.size();
                pointId[p] = sz;
                adj.push_back(vector<int>());
            }
            pointsOnCircle.push_back(p);
        }
        int sz = (int)pointsOnCircle.size();
        for (int j = 0; j < sz; j++) {
            int u = pointId[pointsOnCircle[j]];
            int v = pointId[pointsOnCircle[(j + 1) % sz]];
            if (u != v) {
                adj[u].push_back(v);
                adj[v].push_back(u);
            }
        }
    }

    int vCount = (int)pointId.size();
    int eCount = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < vCount; i++) {
        eCount += (int)adj[i].size();
    }
    eCount /= 2;

    int comps = 0;
    vector<bool> was(vCount, false);
    for (int i = 0; i < vCount; i++) {
        if (!was[i]) {
            ++comps;
            dfs(i, was, adj);
        }
    }

    cout << 1 + comps + eCount - vCount << "\n";

    return 0;
}
